Good to know

Questions?

Call the shop at (601) 736-0663.

Contact Relevant↗
What’s included in the monthly price?

Every plan includes design, hosting, SSL security, automatic backups, and support. Rocket includes up to five pages. Rocket Pro adds more pages and hands-on changes. Get Found Now adds Google Business Profile management and local SEO.

Can I use my existing domain?

Yes. We can connect a domain you already own. We’ll review your domain and email setup so your existing email service can stay where it is.

Can I update the website?

Yes. Rocket supports content editing, and Rocket Pro and Get Found Now include hands-on changes from our team. We’ll help you choose the approach that works for you.

Does local SEO guarantee the top spot on Google?

No. Search visibility depends on competition, location, your business information, content, and other factors. Get Found Now supports your local presence with ongoing work and a monthly performance check-in.

How do I choose a plan?

Tell us about your business, the pages you need, and how much ongoing help you want. We’ll recommend the appropriate plan and review the scope, setup, and service agreement with you.
